model.fields and point model: coupled_living_consumption.py, the agreed coupling (Eqs. 34-36 with the front term -r c/(k+c) n_c . grad phi_3D, TVD superbee, dc/dt kept; point model of Klempt et al. 2026 with Fritsch et al. 2025 case I; consumption g phi_3D sum_i phibar_i c; antibiotic from T* = 1/3 with alpha*_0 = 100; new points inherit the neighbours' living composition)
model.geometry: cervical window of edge 300 um (30 code mm; 1 code mm = 10 um) at the -x flank of the clinical molar crown (tier2b_real/_crown_real_watertight.stl x 100, Open-Full-Jaw, Gholamalizadeh et al. 2022), window centre on the crown surface 150 um above the cervical base, the bottom face of the window in the plane of the cervical base; the crown a rigid voxel body (no biofilm, no nutrient, zero flux)
model.boundary: c = 1 (and a = 1 from T* = 1/3) on the saliva face x = -W/2; zero flux through the cut faces y = +-W/2, z = +W/2, the gingiva face z = -W/2 and the crown
model.start: film of 20 um (2 code mm) on the crown surface over the whole window; mixed: Fritsch's start shares (0.25, 0.30); layered: A on the inner 10 um, B on the outer 10 um
model.stress: real_tooth_submodel.solve_submodel: hex8 B-bar, E = 10 Pa (phi^2 + 1e-3), nu = 0.49, eigenstrain (alpha - 1) I, rigid crown (u = 0), roller on y = +-W/2 (u_y = 0), z = +W/2 and z = -W/2 (u_z = 0), x = -W/2 and the film surface free (elements with phi <= 0.05 dropped); film = phi_3D > 0.5
model.constants: Klempt 2024 Table 2 at physical size in the code's units (1 code mm = 10 um): beta = 0.02 mm^2/T* (2 um^2/T*), r = 10 mm/T* (100 um/T*), k = 1, k_alpha = 1e-3 /T*, penalty 5, g/d = 1 /mm^2 (depletion length 1 mm = 10 um; nutrient and antibiotic), c*_0 = 100, alpha*_0 = 100, s = 0.1, phi_min = 0.001, outer step 0.025
